scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Assistance for Saving in Consumption of Energy and Water
other_conditions: Must be an existing or new enterprise.
Must conduct an energy/water audit through a recognized institution.
Must achieve at least 10% reduction in energy/water consumption after implementing audit recommendations.
Must install equipment as per the auditing authority's recommendations.
Enterprises with increased consumption due to production growth will be reviewed separately.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to ₹50,000 for 75% of audit costs and a subsidy of up to ₹20,00,000 for 25% of recommended equipment cost.
